records.issue_text: `join` can exit early leaving processes unterminated: the `if remaining_time <= 0: break` exits the outer loop before `terminate()` calls for remaining processes, so with multiple processes and a tight deadline, processes after the first are left running
records.rationale: In `SpanFlusher.join`, the outer loop over `self.processes` can `break` when the deadline is exceeded: `if remaining_time <= 0: break`. Because the `terminate()` call is inside the per-process loop body (after the `while process.is_alive()` wait), any processes not yet iterated (i.e., “remaining processes”) will not reach `process.terminate()`. With multiple processes and a tight timeout/deadline, `join` can therefore exit without terminating some still-alive processes.
